sections.subhead: Websites Your Team Can Update In Minutes, Without Calling a Developer

body.text: A CMS (content management system) website lets your team update pages, products, blogs and images from a simple dashboard — no coding required. Teknoppy builds CMS websites in Kochi on WordPress, Drupal or headless platforms, sets up staff logins and permissions, and trains your team live.

Most business websites in Kochi run into the same wall six months after launch: nobody in the company can update them without calling the original developer. We build your site on an intuitive admin architecture from day one, so you remain in full control of your digital presence.

items.text: A properly built CMS gives every page, banner, and service section a clean, editable field in the dashboard. Updates that used to require a developer now take your own staff a few minutes.

items.a: A CMS (Content Management System) website allows non-technical team members to add, edit, and publish content — such as text, images, blogs, and products — through an intuitive dashboard without writing any code.

items.q: Should we choose WordPress, Drupal, or a custom CMS?
items.a: For most small-to-medium businesses, WordPress offers the greatest flexibility, plugin ecosystem, and ease of use. For enterprise security and complex content models, Drupal or headless CMS architectures are better suited.

items.q: How much does CMS website development cost in Kochi?
items.a: CMS website development typically ranges from ₹30,000 for standard business sites to ₹90,000+ for advanced custom post types, multi-tier user permissions, and CRM or booking integrations. See our pricing page for details.

items.q: Can you migrate our existing website into a modern CMS?
items.a: Yes. We safely migrate your pages, blog posts, media library, and SEO meta tags into the new CMS without losing search rankings or URL structures.

items.q: How do you train our team to manage the CMS?
items.a: We provide a live one-on-one walkthrough for your marketing and administrative staff, accompanied by recorded video tutorials for future reference.

items.q: Is a CMS website secure against hackers?
items.a: Yes. We implement automated daily backups, two-factor authentication (2FA), firewall protection, SSL certificates, and role-based staff permissions to ensure your website remains secure.

sections.h2: Ready for a Website Your Team Can Update Itself?
